title: Learning Rate Schedules
body:
A learning rate schedule dynamically adjusts the step size during training to help neural networks converge efficiently.

When training a model with gradient descent, starting with a large step size accelerates initial progress across the loss landscape.

As training progresses, smaller updates prevent the optimization algorithm from overshooting the minimum.

Common strategies include step decay, which drops the value by a factor at fixed intervals, and exponential decay.

Proper tuning ensures stable convergence and better generalization on unseen validation data.
